name: Consolidated Server Data Pipeline
description: Syncs the external read-only Consolidé consolidated_db into a local MySQL, maps it to FHIR with SQLMesh, and routes by resource type through OpenHIM — Patient identities to OpenCR, clinical to the SHR — in one deployment (no mode flag). Set CONSOLIDATED_HOST/USER/PASS. PIPELINE_IMAGE defaults to the GHCR package; set it to sedish-fhir-pipeline:local to build locally.
